title: antirrhinum majus subvar. verticillatum
intro: Antirrhinum majus subvar. verticillatum, commonly known as the upright snapdragon, is a variety of the Antirrhinum majus plant that is characterized by its upright growth habit. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of A. majus subvar. verticillatum include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenylethanoid glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
